assists.copy: This was Ronaldo's first deflected assist. It came in a 3-3 UEFA Cup r96 draw with Partizan Belgrade at Partizan Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first career assist, his first assist for Sporting CP and his first Primeira Liga assist. It came in a 3-1 win over Vitoria Guimaraes at Estádio D. Afonso Henriques.
This was Ronaldo's first assist as a substitute and his first stoppage-time assist. It came in a 3-1 Primeira Liga win over Beira-Mar at Estádio Mário Duarte.
This assist completed Ronaldo's first game with two or more assists, in a 3-2 Primeira Liga defeat to Leiria at Estádio Dr. Magalhães Pessoa. It was his last assist for Sporting CP.

This was Ronaldo's first penalty or free kick won for a teammate to score. It came in a 2-1 Champions League group stage defeat to VfB Stuttgart at Gottlieb-Daimler-Stadion. It was a penalty, which Ruud van Nistelrooy converted.
This was Ronaldo's first assist for Manchester United and his first Premier League assist. It came in a 3-0 win over Portsmouth at Old Trafford.
This was Ronaldo's first assist from a goalkeeper rebound. It came in a 3-0 FA Cup round of 32 win over Northampton Town at Sixfields Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first FA Cup assist. It came in a 3-0 round of 32 win over Northampton Town at Sixfields Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first assist for Portugal and his first international friendly assist. It came in a 2-2 draw with Sweden at Estádio Cidade de Coimbra.
This was Ronaldo's first European Championship assist. It came in a 2-0 group stage win over Russia at Estádio da Luz.
This was Ronaldo's first World Cup qualifying assist. It came in a 2-0 win over Latvia at Skonto Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first Champions League assist. It came in a 2-2 group stage draw with Lyon at Stade de Gerland.
This was Ronaldo's 10th assist for Manchester United. It came in a 1-0 Premier League win over Liverpool at Anfield.
This was Ronaldo's first Champions League qualifying assist. It came in a 3-0 play-off win over Debrecen at Ferenc Puskás Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first assist for an own goal. It came in a 1-1 friendly draw with Northern Ireland at Windsor Park.
This was Ronaldo's 10th Premier League assist. It came in a 3-0 win over Portsmouth at Old Trafford.
This was Ronaldo's first League Cup assist. It came in a 3-1 quarter-final win over Birmingham City at St Andrew's.
This was Ronaldo's 10th assist for Portugal. It came in a 4-2 friendly defeat to Denmark at Brøndby Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first assist from a rebound off the woodwork. It came in a 2-0 Premier League win over Newcastle United at Old Trafford.
Ronaldo won this penalty in a 2-1 Premier League win over Middlesbrough at Riverside Stadium, and Louis Saha converted it.
This was Ronaldo's 25th assist for Manchester United. It came in a 3-1 Champions League group stage win over Benfica at Old Trafford.
This was Ronaldo's first Euro qualifying assist. It came in a 4-0 win over Belgium at Estádio José Alvalade.
This was Ronaldo's 50th career assist. It came in a 7-1 Champions League quarter-final win over Roma at Old Trafford.
This was Ronaldo's 10th deflected assist. It came in a 2-0 FA Cup round of 64 win over Aston Villa at Villa Park.
This was Ronaldo's 25th Premier League assist. It came in a 4-0 win over Aston Villa at Old Trafford.
This assist completed Ronaldo's first game with three or more assists, in a 4-0 Premier League win over Aston Villa at Old Trafford.
This was Ronaldo's 10th assist from a goalkeeper rebound. It came in a 3-2 European Championship quarter-final defeat to Germany at Sankt Jakob-Park.
This was Ronaldo's 10th assist for Wayne Rooney. It came in a 2-0 Premier League win over Bolton Wanderers at Old Trafford.
This was Ronaldo's first Club World Cup assist and his first assist in a final. It came in a 1-0 final win over Liga de Quito at International Stadium Yokohama.
This was Ronaldo's 50th assist for Manchester United. It came in a 1-0 Premier League win over Wigan Athletic at Old Trafford.
This was Ronaldo's first assist for Real Madrid and his first La Liga assist. It came in a 4-2 win over Almeria at Estadio Bernabéu.
This was Ronaldo's 10th Champions League assist. It came in a 3-1 group stage win over Marseille at Stade Vélodrome.
This was Ronaldo's first World Cup assist. It came in a 7-0 group stage win over North Korea at Cape Town Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's 10th La Liga assist. It came in a 3-0 win over Espanyol at Estadio Bernabéu.
This was Ronaldo's 20th assist from a goalkeeper rebound. It came in a 4-0 friendly win over Spain at Estádio da Luz.
This was Ronaldo's first Copa del Rey assist. It came in an 8-0 round of 16 win over Levante at Estadio Bernabéu.
This assist completed Ronaldo's second game with three or more assists, in an 8-1 La Liga win over Almeria at Estadio Bernabéu.
This was Ronaldo's 100th career assist. It came in a 3-0 Champions League group stage win over Ajax at Estadio Bernabéu.
Ronaldo made this assist in a 4-1 La Liga win over Real Betis at Estadio Bernabéu. The match was his 100th appearance for Real Madrid.
This was Ronaldo's 25th La Liga assist. It came in a 4-2 win over Levante at Estadio Bernabéu.
This was Ronaldo's 10th assist for Gonzalo Higuain. It came in a 2-1 La Liga win over Deportivo La Coruna at Estadio Riazor.
This was Ronaldo's 10th assist for Karim Benzema. It came in a 3-1 La Liga win over Real Betis at Estadio Bernabéu.
This was Ronaldo's 50th assist for Real Madrid. It came in a 6-2 La Liga win over Malaga at Estadio Bernabéu.
This was Ronaldo's first El Clásico assist and his first assist in a match against Lionel Messi. It came in a 2-1 La Liga defeat to Barcelona at Camp Nou.
This was Ronaldo's first extra-time assist. It came in a 4-1 Champions League final win over Atletico Madrid at Estádio da Luz.
This was Ronaldo's 50th La Liga assist. It came in a 5-0 win over Athletic Bilbao at Estadio Bernabéu.
Ronaldo made this assist in a 4-0 La Liga win over Granada at Nuevo Los Cármenes. The match was his 700th career appearance.
This was Ronaldo's 150th career assist. It came in a 4-0 La Liga win over Eibar at Estadio Municipal de Ipurúa.
This was Ronaldo's 25th Champions League assist. It came in a 1-0 quarter-final win over Atletico Madrid at Estadio Bernabéu.
This was Ronaldo's 25th assist for Karim Benzema. It came in a 5-0 La Liga win over Deportivo La Coruna at Estadio Bernabéu.
This was Ronaldo's 100th assist for Real Madrid. It came in a 4-0 La Liga win over Eibar at Estadio Bernabéu.
Ronaldo made this assist in a 3-3 European Championship group stage draw with Hungary at Parc Olympique Lyonnais. The match was his 800th career appearance.
This was Ronaldo's 25th assist for Portugal. It came in a 3-0 World Cup qualifying win over Latvia at Skonto Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first Confederations Cup assist. It came in a 2-2 group stage draw with Mexico at Kazan Arena.
This was Ronaldo's 10th World Cup qualifying assist. It came in a 1-0 win over Hungary at Groupama Arena.
This was Ronaldo's 200th career assist. It came in a 7-1 La Liga win over Deportivo La Coruna at Estadio Bernabéu.
Ronaldo made this assist in a 3-0 Champions League quarter-final win over Juventus at Juventus Stadium. It was his last assist for Real Madrid.
This was Ronaldo's first assist for Juventus and his first Serie A assist. It came in a 2-0 win over Lazio at Juventus Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's 10th assist for Juventus. It came in a 3-0 Serie A win over Frosinone at Juventus Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's 10th Serie A assist. It came in a 4-0 win over Cagliari at Juventus Stadium.
Ronaldo made this assist in a 2-0 Serie A win over Inter Milan at Juventus Stadium. The match was his 1,000th career appearance.
This was Ronaldo's 20th deflected assist. It came in a 4-0 Serie A win over Lecce at Juventus Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's 30th assist from a goalkeeper rebound. It came in a 2-0 Serie A win over Sampdoria at Juventus Stadium.
Ronaldo made this assist in a 3-2 Champions League round of 16 win over FC Porto at Juventus Stadium. It was his last assist for Juventus.
This was Ronaldo's first Nations League assist. It came in a 4-0 group stage win over the Czech Republic at Sinobo Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first Europa League assist. It came in a 3-2 group stage win over Omonia at GSP Stadium.
Ronaldo made this assist in a 1-0 Europa League group stage win over Real Sociedad at Anoeta. It was his last assist for Manchester United.
This was Ronaldo's first assist for Al Nassr and his first Saudi Pro League assist. It came in a 2-1 win over Al-Taawoun at King Saud University Stadium.
This assist completed Ronaldo's 25th game with two or more assists, in a 2-1 Saudi Pro League win over Al-Taawoun at King Saud University Stadium.
This was Ronaldo's first AFC Champions League assist. It came in a 4-2 play-off win over Shabab Al Ahli at King Saud University Stadium.

This was Ronaldo's 10th Saudi Pro League assist. It came in a 4-1 win over Al Riyadh at King Saud University Stadium. The match was his 1,200th career appearance.

assists.copy: This was Ronaldo's 250th career assist. It came in an 8-0 Saudi Pro League win over Abha at Prince Sultan bin Abdul Aziz Stadium.

Ronaldo made this assist in a 3-0 European Championship group stage win over Turkey at Signal Iduna Park. It took him to 7 assists at the European Championship finals, the most in the tournament's history.
